metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "A C4 model of the insurance claims platform" {
    configuration {
        scope "Landscape"
    }
    model {
        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"
        staff = person "Staff" "Processes assigned claims"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "Owned and operated by the insurance company" {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress" "Web"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app" "API"
            claimsIntakeService = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims" "Service"
            triageService = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims" "Service"
            assessmentService = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts" "Service"
            payoutService = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements" "Service"
            fraudScreeningService = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims" "Service"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports" "Service"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders" "Service"
            assignmentService = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters" "Service"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims" "Web"
            policyVerificationService = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy" "Service"
            reinsuranceAllocationService = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners" "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation" "Batch"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts" "Queue"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records" "Database"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records" "Database"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail" "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence" "File Store"
        }

        nationalClaimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "Operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "Operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "Reports claims and tracks progress" "HTTPS"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "Reports claims and tracks progress" "HTTPS"
        staff -> adjusterWorkbench "Processes assigned claims" "HTTPS"

        webPortal -> claimsIntakeService "Uses" "HTTPS"
        webPortal -> assessmentService "Uses" "HTTPS"
        webPortal -> payoutService "Uses" "HTTPS"
        webPortal -> documentService "Uses" "HTTPS"
        webPortal -> notificationService "Uses" "HTTPS"

        mobileAppBackend -> claimsIntakeService "Uses" "HTTPS"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessmentService "Uses" "HTTPS"
        mobileAppBackend -> payoutService "Uses" "HTTPS"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "Uses" "HTTPS"
        mobileAppBackend -> notificationService "Uses" "HTTPS"

        claimsIntakeService -> triageService "Hands accepted claims" "Event"
        triageService -> assessmentService "Routes claims" "Event"
        assessmentService -> payoutService "Requests settlements" "Event"

        fraudScreeningService -> nationalClaimsDataBureau "Consults" "HTTPS"
        payoutService -> clearingHouse "Executes settlements through" "HTTPS"

        assignmentService -> adjusterWorkbench "Routes the claim" "Event"

        documentService -> documentStore "Reads from" "S3"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "Reads and writes" "SQL"
        batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "Reads and writes" "SQL"
        notificationService -> policyholder "Reports claim status changes" "Email/SMS"

        policyVerificationService -> policyDatabase "Reads policy and cover records" "SQL"
        reinsuranceAllocationService -> claimsDatabase "Reads large losses" "SQL"
        claimsIntakeService -> eventQueue "Publishes claim events" "Event"
        claimsIntakeService -> auditDatabase "Writes audit trail" "SQL"
    }
    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "System Context" "The system context diagram for Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
        container claimsCenter "Containers" "Containers" "The container diagram for Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
    }
}
